summary: Tested admin password login, admin dashboard, live sessions management, and public live sessions features. All 16 backend tests passed. Admin login with password ShamanicAdmin2026! works correctly. Admin dashboard shows collection cards including live_sessions and astrology_months. Admin live session manager at /admin/manage/live_sessions loads correctly with search, add new, and edit functionality. Public /live page displays session cards with filters. Live session room supports RSVP and chat/Q&A message posting without ObjectId serialization issues.

backend_tests.details: Admin login, collections, live sessions CRUD, RSVP, messages all working

critical_code_review_comments: Admin authentication flow is well-implemented with both password login and session-based login for allowlisted emails
Live sessions API properly excludes MongoDB _id from responses
RSVP and message endpoints handle duplicate RSVPs gracefully (upsert pattern)
AdminRoute component correctly checks for admin_token in localStorage before falling back to session auth

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All admin and live session features working)

seed_data_creation: None - existing live session seed data used for testing
